cohort: 769 women prior to their labor induction
finding: Maternal satisfaction with labor induction was independently associated with maternal education, previous cesarean delivery, maternal involvement in decision-making, adequacy of labor induction information provided, decision-making time pressure, amniotomy, induction to delivery interval, mode of delivery, postpartum hemorrhage, and neonatal admission.
mod_finding: Mode of delivery was an independent predictor of maternal satisfaction with labor induction.
